metadata.description: Gnapi team's Claude Code plugin marketplace — shared skills, commands, and agents.

plugins.name: gnapi-scaffolding
plugins.description: Scaffolders that bake Gnapi house rules (lint, prettier, pre-commit, CI) into new services from day one.

plugins.name: gnapi-standards
plugins.description: Pre-code hook that injects Gnapi coding standards (TDD, SOLID, DRY, naming, why/how comments, no hard-coded literals, structured logging + tracing, error management with catch-must-act) before Claude writes source files, plus a pre-push reminder to run the code-reviewer + QA review gate.
